name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
The single best cross-department improvement is to standardize a shared glossary of terms for AI-generated content across Creative, Operations, and Legal. Creative will draft it, Operations will enforce it in workflows, and Legal will validate compliance. This eliminates conflicting terminology in transcripts, contracts, and deliverables.

Trade-off: It slows initial rollout by 1-2 weeks but prevents costly rework from misaligned language later.

name: Scriv
text: The glossary won’t stop contradictions—it just moves the fight to who gets to define the terms. The real risk is that Legal, Operations, and Creative will each lock their definitions to protect their own goals, making the glossary a weapon, not a tool. Instead, freeze the current terminology in a single artifact now—no debate on wording—then let a neutral AI audit every future output for consistency. Done when the artifact exists and the AI’s audit log is live.
